+def widened_hostnames(hostname: Optional[str]) -> Iterable[str]:
+    """Yield a hostname, then each parent formed by removing its first label."""
+    while hostname:
+        yield hostname
+        hostname = hostname.partition('.')[2]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source', ['runtime', 'config'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('listed_host', ['example.com', 'example.com.'])
+def test_blocked_parent_domain(
+    config_stub, config_tmpdir, data_tmpdir, host_blocker_factory,
+    source, listed_host,
+):
+    """A listed domain covers itself and deeper subdomains from either file."""
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.hosts.lists = ['https://example.org/list']
+
+    directory = data_tmpdir if source == 'runtime' else config_tmpdir
+    (directory / 'blocked-hosts').write_text(listed_host + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
+
+    host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    host_blocker.read_hosts()
+
+    for url in (
+        'https://example.com/',
+        'https://sub.example.com/path',
+        'https://a.b.example.com/path',
+        'https://a.b.example.com./path',
+    ):
+        assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(url))
+
+    for url in ('https://notexample.com/', 'https://example.org/'):
+        assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(url))
+
+
+def test_parent_domain_whitelist(config_stub, host_blocker_factory):
+    """A URL whitelist overrides blocked parent domains in both sets."""
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = [
+        'https://a.b.example.com/allowed/*',
+    ]
+
+    host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    host_blocker._blocked_hosts.add('example.com')
+    host_blocker._config_blocked_hosts.add('b.example.com')
+
+    assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(
+        'https://a.b.example.com/allowed/script.js'))
+    assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(
+        'https://a.b.example.com/blocked/script.js'))
+    assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(
+        'https://other.example.com/allowed/script.js'))
+
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = False
+    assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(
+        'https://a.b.example.com/blocked/script.js'))
+
+
